static_findings.snippet: `firecrawl` 是一个多功能网页抓取和数据提取工具,通过 `mode` 参数调用不同功能。其 `parameters` 结构是嵌套的。
- `scrape`、`search`、`map` 是同步操作,立即返回结果
- `crawl`、`extract` 是异步操作,返回 `job_id` 用于后续状态检查
- 所有参数都必须在 `parameters` 对象内,不要放在顶层
- URL 必须以 `http://` 或 `https://` 开头
### ➡️ 示例 1: 抓取单个网页 (`scrape`)
### ➡️ 示例 3: 获取网站地图 (`map`)
### ➡️ 示例 4: 异步爬取网站 (`crawl`)
*此调用会返回一个 `job_id`,用于后续查询。*
### ➡️ 示例 5: 结构化数据提取 (`extract`)
### ➡️ 示例 6: 检查异步任务状态 (`check_status`)
- **使用无效的 URL 格式:** `{"mode": "scrape", "parameters": {"url": "example.com"}}` (缺少协议)
- URL 必须以 `http://` 或 `https://` 开头
- **错误的参数类型:** `{"mode": "extract", "parameters": {"urls": "https://example.com"}}` (urls 应该是数组)

content.value_statement: Teams often need web content in clean formats without writing custom scrapers. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Firecrawl modes for scraping, search, maps, crawling, extraction, and status checks.
actual_capabilities: Shows how to scrape a single web page and request markdown or HTML output.
Shows how to run web searches with a query and result limit.
Shows how to request a site map from a target URL.
Shows how to start asynchronous crawl jobs with a crawl limit.
Shows how to extract structured fields from one or more URLs.
Shows how to check an asynchronous job with a job identifier.
limitations: Requires the Firecrawl tool to be installed and available in the agent environment.
Documents tool calls only; it does not include a Firecrawl implementation.
Asynchronous crawl and extract modes require a separate status check.
Results depend on target site access, robots rules, and Firecrawl service limits.

use_cases.title: Collect Research Sources
use_cases.description: Gather page content, search results, and site maps for topic research without writing scraper code.

use_cases.title: Prepare Content for Analysis
use_cases.description: Convert web pages into markdown or HTML before summarization, comparison, or extraction tasks.

use_cases.title: Extract Fields from Articles
use_cases.description: Use extraction prompts and schemas to capture titles, authors, dates, and other structured fields.

prompt_templates.title: Scrape One Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one known URL.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Firecrawl scrape mode for this URL. Return the page content in markdown and note any access problems.

prompt_templates.title: Search a Topic
prompt_templates.scenario: Find a small set of relevant pages.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Firecrawl search mode for this topic with a limit of five results. Summarize the most relevant pages.

prompt_templates.title: Map a Website
prompt_templates.scenario: Discover important pages before deeper review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Firecrawl map mode for this website. Group discovered URLs by likely purpose and flag pages worth scraping.

prompt_templates.title: Run Structured Extraction
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced extraction from one or more articles.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Firecrawl extract mode on these URLs. Extract title, author, publish date, summary, and source URL, then check job status.

output_examples.input: Scrape a product documentation page for markdown content.
output_examples.output: A cleaned markdown version of the page, with headings, links, and key sections preserved for review.

output_examples.input: Search for recent articles about a technical topic.
output: A short ranked list of relevant pages.
A brief note explaining why each result matches the query.
Source URLs for follow-up scraping or citation.

output_examples.input: Extract article metadata from several news URLs.
output_examples.output: A structured summary containing each article title, author, publish time, and a concise content summary.

best_practices: Use full URLs with http or https, because Firecrawl expects complete URL formats.
Keep crawl limits small until you understand the target site size and result quality.
Use status checks for crawl and extract jobs before assuming asynchronous work is complete.
anti_patterns: Do not place mode-specific parameters at the top level of the request.
Do not pass a single string when extract mode expects an array of URLs.
Do not crawl large sites without clear limits, scope, and permission to access the content.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It explains how to call Firecrawl modes for scraping, search, site maps, crawling, extraction, and status checks.

faq.question: Does this skill include the Firecrawl service?
faq.answer: No. It requires the Firecrawl tool to already be available in the agent environment.

faq.question: Which modes return results immediately?
faq.answer: Scrape, search, and map are documented as synchronous modes that return results immediately.

faq.question: Which modes need a follow-up check?
faq.answer: Crawl and extract are documented as asynchronous modes that return a job identifier for later status checks.

faq.question: Can it extract structured data?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill shows extract mode with prompts and schemas for fields such as title, author, and publish time.

faq.question: What URL format should I use?
faq.answer: Use complete URLs that start with http or https, as shown in the skill guidance.
